Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #408 · 2026-10-27T04:44Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #408 as item 1 of 5 (five devx cards: two new gates asked, two governed slices awaiting a review spend, one CI wall-clock follow-up). Seat increment (re-read on `origin/main` `26e7c75e9a`; the card is not restated):
- P1 holds: `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` has 8 entries, `Test UI` absent; `Test Core` is enrolled through the `test-gate` aggregate (`ci.yml:1702–1706`: `name:` and `if: always()` both load-bearing) — the shape A copies.
- P5 measured as far as the API allows: of the 100 newest failed merge-queue builds, **27 failed on `Test UI` alone** (and merged, since nothing required it); of the 100 newest red `main` runs (10-22 → 10-27), **27 carry a red `Test UI` shard** — mostly repeats of the same deterministic red across consecutive pushes (two distinct causes carded in two days: #26234, #26421). Four `Queue-flake anchor` cards in two days name ui test files (#26222, #26223, #26247, #26422). So A would turn both the deterministic reds and the flakes into ejections; the flake share of the 27 is not separable from here.
- Half-state read, not written: `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` together; the second leaves in the ruling's stroke.
- Facets (the card's block, re-read): ① A removes the core/ui asymmetry the merge left; ② two main reds in two days; ③ A refuses before merge, B cannot stop a queued PR (P3); ④ a new gate, the maintainer's flip; no extra runtime.
- The seat agrees with **A, staged as the card says**: the lane first measures the ui flake rate on the last 50 queue builds and fixes the named flakes (the four anchors), then lands the aggregate job and the maintainer enrols the context in the same sitting. Not B (does not close the gap) and not C. Workload: devx · 1 Tier H PR · XS, plus the flake fixes in the ui lane first.
Prior rulings read: required contexts · Test UI advisory → #25752 ruling 30 (B), step 6 enrolments; 「新增门禁默认否」; thread: #26422, #26421.

Ruling: batch #408 item 1 · letter A (staged) · maintainer 「批 #408  同意」 2026-10-27T06:24Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #408 with 「批 #408  同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6433960457. Letter **A, staged as the card and the brief say**, and the maintainer's yes is the explicit flip of 「新增门禁默认否」 for this one context: a `Test UI` aggregate job over the 16 shards (the `test-gate` shape, `ci.yml:1702–1706`: `name:` literal and `if: always()` both load-bearing), enrolled in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` and in the ruleset by the maintainer in the same sitting as the merge (#9325's two halves; precedent `Lint UI` / `Build & E2E UI` on 10-26). **Order:** first the ui lane measures the ui flake rate on the last 50 queue builds and fixes the flakes the four anchors name (#26222, #26223, #26247, #26422 — "a failing test is never an infra flake"); the aggregate lands after that reading is on this card. Not B (cannot stop a queued PR, P3) and not C.

Seat measurement on the card: 27 of the 100 newest failed queue builds failed on `Test UI` alone and merged; 27 of the 100 newest red `main` runs carry a `Test UI` shard red. Workload: devx · 1 Tier H PR (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, lands by the maintainer's approval) · XS, after the ui lane's flake fixes (S, their own cards or one PR).

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:devx`, p1, `area:devpath`); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Test UI flake reading (ui step 1 of ruling 6435318516) · ui seat 1 card thread · `session_01ADHkmRBcYqig1yVS7FYsGL` · 2026-10-27T07:51Z

**Result: no Test UI flake is live on `main`. The ui step is complete, so `domain:devx` can land the `Test UI` aggregate.**

Source: the Actions API, workflow `CI` (id 224644133), `event=merge_group`, every job of every attempt (`filter=all`). A red shard is classified from its check-run annotations (the failing test file and the assertion). Two terms: a *build* is one merge-group `CI` run, and *ran Test UI* means its 16 `Test UI (k/16)` shards ran rather than being skipped by the `ui` filter. No build in any window below had a re-run attempt or a cancelled Test UI shard.

### 1. Main reading: the newest 50 queue builds that ran Test UI

| | |
|:--|:--|
| Window | 2026-10-26 23:32Z → 2026-10-27 07:10Z (run 40465493520 is the newest completed) |
| Builds / shards | 50 builds · 800 shard jobs |
| Red shards | 4, in 4 builds |
| (a) deterministic, inherited | **4**: `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts` L2893 / L2917, `expected 1 to be greater than or equal to 15`. Root #26419 (`d15f99d72f`) moved the workflows' literal `node-version:` lines to `.nvmrc`. Builds 40443632873 (#26419, root), 40443739774 (#26325), 40443830059 (#26412) and 40446655069 (#26426) were stacked on it or on `main` after it merged. Fixed by #26421 → PR #26432, `6746140361` |
| (b) flake | **0** |
| (c) real defect in the queued PR | **0** |
| **Flake rate** | **0 / 50** |

### 2. The literal reading: the newest 50 queue builds of any kind

Window 2026-10-27 04:20Z → 07:10Z. Only **18** of those 50 ran Test UI (288 shards). The other 32 skipped it because their diff did not reach `ui/`. **0 red, flake rate 0 / 50.** That is why section 1 counts builds that ran Test UI: 18 builds over three hours is too thin to measure a flake rate.

### 3. 24-hour extension, to reach the four anchors and their fixes

Window 2026-10-26 07:31Z → 2026-10-27 07:10Z: 395 completed queue builds, 31 red. 165 of them ran Test UI (2640 shards).

| Test file | Hits (build, time Z) | Class | Fix on `main` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts` L175 and `…retiredObjectEnabled.test.ts` L161, `expected 48 to be 47` (anchors #26222, #26223) | 7 builds, 10-26 15:46 → 16:42 (#26177, #26053, #26197, #26033, #26158 ×2, #26203) | (a): #26005 adopted `sharing` as the 48th `ObjectSchema` key, and the corpus guards pinned 47 | PR #26231, `a1477dec8a` |
| `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.shellLeave-13231.test.tsx` L195, `Unable to find … Profile page` (anchor #26096) | 3 independent: 40293762961 (#25996, 08:39), 40316529606 (#26057, 11:38), 40337868008 (#26027, 14:14) | (b): after the save, the page's unsaved-edits registration was still held when the test clicked, so the leave was cancelled (os-dev report on #26096) | PR #26212, `f42b55f2f3`, test-only |
| `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/buildIdentity-12970.test.ts` L41, `expected '1bbb7bf490' to be null` | 1: 40325012039 (#26019, 12:45) | (b): the console project's `VITE_APP_VERSION` define leaked into `process.env`, and it went red only when another project's config resolved after the console's | PR #26197 (#26126), `f143cd8809` |
| `vi.mock` errors across `ui/apps/console`, with Build Core red on app-shell `Cannot redeclare block-scoped variable 'isNew'` | 40316357014 (#26056, 11:36) plus 7 builds stacked behind it, 11:37 → 11:48 | (c): #26056's own group, on the green #26057 group `d6b39f6376`. #26056 was corrected and merged at 12:51 as `6d15acabda` | in the PR before it landed |
| `doc-version-claims.test.ts` (anchor #26422) | the 4 builds in section 1 | (a) | PR #26432, `6746140361` |

The anchor #26247 (`plugin-security/src/controlled-by-parent-owner-may-edit.test.ts`) is a `Test Core (5/8)` red (builds 40355861805 and 40358686385), not Test UI. It was one deterministic break from #26064's queued commit `17f21e8d`, and #26064 fixed it before landing (`733b3c849a`). No queue build after that has a red Test Core shard.

### Fixes verified on `main`

Each fix commit is an ancestor of `origin/main` `f48aa4510`. `git merge-base --is-ancestor` gave exit 0 for `a1477dec8a`, `733b3c849a`, `6746140361`, `f42b55f2f3` and `f143cd8809`, and an exit 0 proves itself even in a shallow checkout. No test file named above has gone red in a queue build since its fix landed:

| Fix | Queue builds that ran Test UI after it landed | Red shards from that file |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #26197 (16:06Z 10-26) | 104 | 0 |
| #26212 (16:58Z 10-26) | 98 | 0 |
| #26231 (17:10Z 10-26) | 98 | 0 |
| #26432 (04:12Z 10-27) | 19 | 0 (no red shard at all) |

### For the aggregate

In the last 24 hours, every Test UI red in the queue had a named cause that is now fixed on `main`. 15 of the 31 red builds were Test UI alone (one red shard or several, from one cause). Under ruling A the required aggregate would refuse each of those queue entries, which is the intended refusal. Two flake files in 24 hours were both fixed within hours, and 98+ builds since then are clean. So this reading gives no reason to hold back the enrolment. No PR was opened for this step: no flake file is still live, so step 2 of the dispatch had nothing to fix.

Caveat: merge-group Test UI runs only the shards' **affected** selection (`ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs`), so a flake in a file that no queued diff selects stays out of this reading. The scheduled full battery on `main` is the backstop for those files.
